verses.ar: وَعَادَ أَيُّوبُ يَنْطِقُ بِمَثَلِهِ فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,

verses.ar: «يَا لَيْتَنِي كَمَا فِي ٱلشُّهُورِ ٱلسَّالِفَةِ وَكَٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلَّتِي حَفِظَنِي ٱللهُ فِيهَا،
verses.kjv: Oh that I were as [in] months past, as [in] the days [when] God preserved me;
verses.web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

verses.ar: حِينَ أَضَاءَ سِرَاجَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَبِنُورِهِ سَلَكْتُ ٱلظُّلْمَةَ.
verses.kjv: When his candle shined upon my head, [and when] by his light I walked [through] darkness;
verses.web: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

verses.ar: كَمَا كُنْتُ فِي أَيَّامِ خَرِيفِي، وَرِضَا ٱللهِ عَلَى خَيْمَتِي،
verses.kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God [was] upon my tabernacle;
verses.web: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَدِيرُ بَعْدُ مَعِي وَحَوْلِي غِلْمَانِي،
verses.kjv: When the Almighty [was] yet with me, [when] my children [were] about me;
verses.web: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

verses.ar: إِذْ غَسَلْتُ خَطَوَاتِي بِٱللَّبَنِ، وَٱلصَّخْرُ سَكَبَ لِي جَدَاوِلَ زَيْتٍ.
verses.kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.web: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

verses.ar: حِينَ كُنْتُ أَخْرُجُ إِلَى ٱلْبَابِ فِي ٱلْقَرْيَةِ، وَأُهَيِّئُ فِي ٱلسَّاحَةِ مَجْلِسِي.
verses.kjv: When I went out to the gate through the city, [when] I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.web: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

verses.ar: رَآنِي ٱلْغِلْمَانُ فَٱخْتَبَأُوا، وَٱلْأَشْيَاخُ قَامُوا وَوَقَفُوا.
verses.kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, [and] stood up.
verses.web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

verses.ar: ٱلْعُظَمَاءُ أَمْسَكُوا عَنِ ٱلْكَلَامِ، وَوَضَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The princes refrained talking, and laid [their] hand on their mouth.
verses.web: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلشُّرَفَاءِ ٱخْتَفَى، وَلَصِقَتْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ بِأَحْنَاكِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.web: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْأُذُنَ سَمِعَتْ فَطَوَّبَتْنِي، وَٱلْعَيْنَ رَأَتْ فَشَهِدَتْ لِي،
verses.kjv: When the ear heard [me], then it blessed me; and when the eye saw [me], it gave witness to me:
verses.web: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي أَنْقَذْتُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ ٱلْمُسْتَغِيثَ وَٱلْيَتِيمَ وَلَا مُعِينَ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and [him that had] none to help him.
verses.web: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

verses.ar: بَرَكَةُ ٱلْهَالِكِ حَلَّتْ عَلَيَّ، وَجَعَلْتُ قَلْبَ ٱلْأَرْمَلَةِ يُسَرُّ.
verses.kjv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.web: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

verses.ar: لَبِسْتُ ٱلْبِرَّ فَكَسَانِي. كَجُبَّةٍ وَعِمَامَةٍ كَانَ عَدْلِي.
verses.kjv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment [was] as a robe and a diadem.
verses.web: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

verses.ar: كُنْتُ عُيُونًا لِلْعُمْيِ، وَأَرْجُلًا لِلْعُرْجِ.
verses.kjv: I was eyes to the blind, and feet [was] I to the lame.
verses.web: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

verses.ar: أَبٌ أَنَا لِلْفُقَرَاءِ، وَدَعْوَى لَمْ أَعْرِفْهَا فَحَصْتُ عَنْهَا.
verses.kjv: I [was] a father to the poor: and the cause [which] I knew not I searched out.
verses.web: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

verses.ar: هَشَّمْتُ أَضْرَاسَ ٱلظَّالِمِ، وَمِنْ بَيْنِ أَسْنَانِهِ خَطَفْتُ ٱلْفَرِيسَةَ.
verses.kjv: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.web: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ: إِنِّي فِي وَكْرِي أُسَلِّمُ ٱلرُّوحَ، وَمِثْلَ ٱلسَّمَنْدَلِ أُكَثِّرُ أَيَّامًا.
verses.kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply [my] days as the sand.
verses.web: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

verses.ar: أَصْلِي كَانَ مُنْبَسِطًا إِلَى ٱلْمِيَاهِ، وَٱلطَّلُّ بَاتَ عَلَى أَغْصَانِي.
verses.kjv: My root [was] spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

verses.ar: كَرَامَتِي بَقِيَتْ حَدِيثَةً عِنْدِي، وَقَوْسِي تَجَدَّدَتْ فِي يَدِي.
verses.kjv: My glory [was] fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

verses.ar: لِي سَمِعُوا وَٱنْتَظَرُوا، وَنَصَتُوا عِنْدَ مَشُورَتِي.
verses.kjv: Unto me [men] gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

verses.ar: بَعْدَ كَلَامِي لَمْ يُثَنُّوا، وَقَوْلِي قَطَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

verses.ar: وَٱنْتَظَرُونِي مِثْلَ ٱلْمَطَرِ، وَفَغَرُوا أَفْوَاهَهُمْ كَمَا لِلْمَطَرِ ٱلْمُتَأَخِّرِ.
verses.kjv: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.
verses.web: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

verses.ar: إِنْ ضَحِكْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ لَمْ يُصَدِّقُوا، وَنُورَ وَجْهِي لَمْ يُعَبِّسُوا.
verses.kjv: [If] I laughed on them, they believed [it] not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.web: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

verses.ar: كُنْتُ أَخْتَارُ طَرِيقَهُمْ وَأَجْلِسُ رَأْسًا، وَأَسْكُنُ كَمَلِكٍ فِي جَيْشٍ، كَمَنْ يُعَزِّي ٱلنَّائِحِينَ.
verses.kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one [that] comforteth the mourners.
verses.web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
